data_fields.name: crit_uses_max_damage
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: crit replaces base roll with MaxDamage

data_fields.name: monster_health_rounding
data_fields.donor_constant: round to whole points, death at <= 0

best_idea: Use one armour curve K/(AL+K) and one additive combiner for damage multipliers (sum as ratings, convert back) so stacked buffs cannot multiply past what a designer tuned.
decision_why: The armour curve and additive combine give a diminishing, auditable stack that fits one damage step in src/fight; the 20-factor product and the per-hit cloak and lifestone branches do not fit, so take the shape only.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a 100-damage hit against armour level 66.67 deals 50 health, and that two +50 damage-rating buffs give x2.0 (not x2.25).
